stem: One promotion put both Earbuds Pro X and Earbuds Lite on 20% off. An analyst measures the promotion's cannibalisation and counts the change in Lite's sales as a loss or gain of a sister product. Under Voltmarkt's convention, what is wrong with this?

options.text: Lite should count, but only after dropping its weeks with no sales
Lite is in the same promotion, so it leaves the sister products
Lite belongs in the halo effect, since it sits in the same category
Lite should count, but with last year's weeks as its baseline
